scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD HOUSE - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Establish narrator's nervous insistence on sanity and acute hearing as he begins the confession
visual_beats: cramped aged interior of worn wood and plaster
NARRATOR alone face taut eyes alert in rumpled day clothes
addresses unseen listener with forced calm
touches ear listening outward

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Introduce the murder motive via the vulture eye while showing first stealth entry with dark lantern
visual_beats: pitch-black room shutters fastened heavy bed
OLD MAN asleep in linen nightshirt
NARRATOR in dark clothes holds closed tin dark lantern
eases door open thrusts lantern then head with exaggerated caution

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - DAY
scenes.purpose: Show daytime kindness and dissimulation that conceals the nightly plot
visual_beats: morning light through ajar shutters
NARRATOR neat in waistcoat enters boldly smiling
OLD MAN sits up in heavy bed
NARRATOR clasps shoulder kindly after hearty inquiry

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Compress seven midnight visits proving cunning; eye always closed so work impossible
visual_beats: montage of seven nights at latch
NARRATOR opens gap inserts closed lantern thrusts head slowly
single thin ray toward pillow
eye always closed then withdraws

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Eighth-night entry; triumph; thumb slip; old man wakes; hour of frozen stillness
visual_beats: room black as pitch shutters fastened
NARRATOR hand on latch slower than watch minute hand chuckles
OLD MAN stirs; door pushed steadily; thumb slips on tin
OLD MAN sits up listening; NARRATOR frozen motionless full hour

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Groan of terror; lantern crevice; ray on open vulture eye; heartbeat begins; murder and confirmation of death
visual_beats: NARRATOR motionless in doorway gap
slight groan; private chuckle of pity
tiny crevice opens; spider-thread ray on pale blue filmed eye
NARRATOR holds ray steady as sound grows; yells throws lantern open leaps
drags OLD MAN down pulls heavy bed over him
smiles gaily; muffled beats cease; hand on chest confirms stone dead

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Dismember corpse; hide parts under floorboards; tub catches blood; four o'clock knock
visual_beats: dim lantern; clinical dismemberment head arms legs
tub catches all; three planks lifted
parts deposited between scantlings; boards replaced flush no stain
bell strikes four; knocking heard from below

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD HOUSE - STREET DOOR - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Police arrive; narrator greets with light heart and false explanation
visual_beats: NARRATOR in rumpled day clothes opens heavy street door light of heart
three officers in dark frock coats caps removed enter suave
NARRATOR smiles welcomes; claims shriek was dream old man in country

scenes.heading: INT. OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Officers sit above corpse; ringing becomes heartbeat; narrator's frenzy and final confession
visual_beats: NARRATOR shows treasures brings chairs sits directly on burial spot
officers satisfied chat pleasantly smile
NARRATOR grows pale rubs temple; ringing resolves to heartbeat
paces foams raves grates chair on boards
shrieks confession points at floorboards; officers' smiles vanish
